purpose: Quality assurance of glycaemic control at baseline, the year 2023.
question: What was the mean HbA1c of patients with type 2 diabetes who had an HbA1c measured in 2023, for women and men?
definitions: Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use each patient's most recent HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) measured within 2023. Patients with no HbA1c in 2023 are left out.
Report per sex: patients with type 2 diabetes with an HbA1c in 2023 and their mean HbA1c, one decimal.
